description: CONCEPT FIDELITY — Lantern Cloister, composited from the Blender blockout export.
notes: Simulation-identical to `concept_lantern_cloister` by construction: same arena, same start,
same wave. Only the room's rendering differs, which is why the three are separate encounters
rather than one encounter with a toggle — two runs are comparable when the only thing that
changed is the thing being compared.
This one composites `src/assets/rooms/concept-lantern-cloister/blockout/`, the layered PNGs.
